decisions.reason: As an award-winning flagship Christmas stollen with clear prestige value and strong fit to the firm's seasonal confectionery business, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

After other new breads were removed, this dark barley malt rye bread remains the retained differentiated bread innovation, though artisanal bread lines are still reviewed closely for sales performance.
The marzipan Christmas stollen is a well-matched seasonal variant that broadens the holiday assortment and gift appeal, with only limited risk of range simplification.
